description: Check moving an npm or PyPI package from one version to another: advisories fixed or introduced, KEV, licence, runtime. Returns go, review or no_go.

from.description: The version you run now: an exact version or an npm dist-tag

name.description: Package name, e.g. express, requests; a scoped npm name is URL-encoded in the path (%40types%2Fnode)

project_license.description: Your project licence, one SPDX id (e.g. MIT, Apache-2.0, GPL-3.0-only) or proprietary; default proprietary

to.description: The version you move to; default the latest. An exact version or an npm dist-tag

use.description: How the package is used: distribute (default), saas or internal

name: stackfacts_upgrade_delta
